frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original whole organism: two staggered rows of high dorsal plates and four tail spikes.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Sophie, NHMUK PV R36730. Mounted skeleton and unmounted elements inspected in Maidment et al.2015 Figure1. Not fully skeletally mature; model is this size class, not a maximum-sized adult.
uncertainties: Soft tissue, colour, keratin thickness and exact mounted posture are reconstructions.
Left arm and tail base incompleteness require symmetry/comparative reconstruction; sex is unknown despite nickname Sophie.
Plate exact lateral tilt and tail spike angle are artistic approximations, not new osteological measurements.
